primaryChecks.text: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in Oboth.

context.text: Moses made a serpent of bronze, and set it on the pole. If a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked at the serpent of bronze, he lived.
They traveled from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrise.

primaryChecks.text: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrise.

context.text: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in Oboth.
From there they traveled, and encamped in the valley of Zered.

primaryChecks.text: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.

context.text: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.
They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.

context.text: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.
